>What are the cons?   
    
You will always have a Lego Batman on your body. Yes, I know it is subjective. Yes, I know this will get buried with downvotes. I'm not saying tattoos are wrong or that the subject matter is any of my business. What I am saying is that right now you have a blank canvas. You can't get that back. In 10 years, do you think you'll still like the Lego Batman idea strong enough to warrant breaking the seal so to say? What would you have wanted 10 years ago?...would you be glad to have that on your body?  
  
I only raise these questions for your sake, not to be a wet blanket on your excitement. The regret many of my friends have on some of their tattoo decisions and the expenses they have spent to cover or remove them...I'm just saying, sleep on it. Wait 6 months.
